responsibility: Implements the gcov-tool command-line utility for offline manipulation of gcda profile directories. This file parses the top-level and subcommand options, dispatches merge, rewrite, and overlap operations, reads profile directory contents into gcov_info lists via helper routines, removes and recreates output gcda trees, and invokes library-style profile transforms such as weighted merging, normalization, scaling, dumping, and overlap scoring. Its role is orchestration of batch profile processing outside the compiler rather than gcov report generation or low-level file-format decoding.
